Name: Authorized user deletes a book from collection
Description:
Precondition: user is created via API, token is generated, 1 book is added to collection.
UI: profile is opened via cookie injection, book is deleted via Trash icon
with confirmation in modal window.
Expected: book disappears from table on UI, and books array in GET /User becomes empty.

Name: Search for a book by its full title
Description:
Preconditions: The user is not logged in, and the Book Store page is open.
UI: The full book title is entered into the search field.
Verification: Only this book remains in the table; no other books are displayed.

Name: User adds a book to collection
Description:
Precondition: user is created via API, auth cookies are injected into browser.
UI: Profile is opened -> navigate to Book Store -> select book ->
click 'Add To Collection' and close alert.
Verification: via API (GET /Account/v1/User) verify that the ISBN of the added book
appeared in the user's collection.

Name: Creating a user with an already taken username is rejected
Description:
Precondition: a user is created via API.
Request: POST /Account/v1/User again with the same username.
Verification: the request is rejected with the 'User exists' error
(status, error code and message).

Name: Authorized user sees their name and profile icon
Description:
Precondition: a new test user is created via API, user is authorized
(session is established). UI: Book Store page is opened.
Verification: Login button is not visible on the page, user name on the page
matches the one used for login.

Name: Login without a required field is rejected with a validation error (KNOWN ISSUE)
Description:
Request: POST /Account/v1/Login with userName and/or password absent from the JSON body.
Verification (desired behaviour): the input is handled gracefully (no server error,
no internal details in the body) and rejected with the validation error.

Known issue: the application crashes with HTTP 500 and returns a stack trace
(README, Findings #5). Until it is fixed the test is reported as skipped;
when the behaviour is fixed, the test fails to remind that the marker must be removed.

Name: User cannot login with incorrect password
Description:
Precondition: a new test user is created via API, user is not authorized.
UI: attempt to authorize with incorrect password is made.
Verification: incorrect password message appears on the page.
User remains on login page.

Name: Create a user with valid credentials
Description:
Request: POST /Account/v1/User with a unique username and a valid password.
Verification: status 201; the body contains a userID in UUID format
and the username that was sent. The userID is stored for cleanup.

Name: Unauthorized user sees Login button
Description:
Precondition: user is unauthorized (no session).
UI: Book Store page is opened.
Verification: Login button is visible on the page.

Name: Login with valid credentials
Description:
Precondition: a user is created via API.
Request: POST /Account/v1/Login with the user's credentials.
Verification: status 200; the body contains the userId of the created user,
the username that was sent, a token and an expiration date in the future.

Name: Creating a user without a required field is rejected
Description:
Request: POST /Account/v1/User with userName and/or password absent from the JSON body.
Verification: the request is rejected with status 400 and the
'UserName and Password required' error.

Name: Login with a non-existing user does not authenticate anyone
Description:
Request: POST /Account/v1/Login with credentials of a user that was never created.
Verification: no authentication data is returned (empty body).

Known deviation: the application answers 200 instead of an error status (README, Findings).

Name: Creating a user with an empty field value is rejected
Description:
Request: POST /Account/v1/User with an empty string as userName and/or password.
Verification: the request is rejected with status 400 and the
'UserName and Password required' error.

Name: Login with an empty field value does not authenticate the user
Description:
Request: POST /Account/v1/Login with an empty string as userName and/or password.
Verification: no authentication data is returned (empty body).

Known deviation: unlike an absent field, an empty value is not rejected with a
validation error; the application answers 200 (README, Findings).

Name: Verify book details page content and URL
Description:
Preconditions: User is not logged in; the Book Store page is open.
UI: Click on the book in the table.
Verification: The page for that specific book opens (check URL); the title, author, publisher,
a non-empty description, and ISBN are displayed.

Name: Login response does not expose the user's password (KNOWN ISSUE)
Description:
Precondition: a user is created via API.
Request: POST /Account/v1/Login with the user's credentials.
Verification (desired behaviour): the response body does not contain the user's password.

Known issue: the application returns the password in plain text (README, Findings #1).
Until it is fixed the test is reported as skipped; when it is fixed,
the test fails to remind that the marker must be removed.

Name: Search by part of the title
Description:
The user is not logged in; the Book Store page is open.
UI: Part of the title is entered into the search field.
Verification: The result is not empty; every displayed book contains the entered text.

Name: Authorized user can successfully log out
Description:
Precondition: A new test user is created via API, user is authorized.
UI: User clicks the Logout button on the Profile page.
Verification: User is redirected to the Login page, check that the 'token'
cookie is cleared/empty. Re-open Profile page directly via URL. Verify that
application shows unauthenticated state (warning message with Login and Register links).
Verify that the 'token' cookie remains empty and session was not restored.

Name: Login with an empty field value does not authenticate the user
Description:
Request: POST /Account/v1/Login with an empty string as userName and/or password.
Verification: no authentication data is returned (empty body).

Known deviation: unlike an absent field, an empty value is not rejected with a
validation error; the application answers 200 (README, Findings).

Name: Verify main elements of Books page are displayed
Description:
Preconditions: The user is not logged in, and the Book Store page is open.
Verification of URL, title, books table, search, pagination and columns (Title, Author, Publisher)

Description:

Verification: the request is rejected with status 400 and the
'UserName and Password required' error.
